mapper.insert: insert into student (name, no, gender, phone, id_card, is_college, address, degree, graduation_date, clazz_id, violation_count, violation_score) values (#{name}, #{no}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{isCollege}, #{address}, #{degree}, #{graduationDate}, #{clazzId}, #{violationCount}, #{violationScore})
mapper.update:
update student
name = #{name},
no = #{no},
gender = #{gender},
phone = #{phone},
is_college = #{isCollege},
id_card = #{idCard},
address = #{address},
degree = #{degree},
graduation_date = #{graduationDate},
clazz_id = #{clazzId},
violation_count = #{violationCount},
violation_score = #{violationScore},
clazz_name = #{clazzName},
id = #{id}
update student set violation_count = IFNULL(violation_count, 0) + #{violation}, violation_score = IFNULL(violation_score, 0) + #{score}, update_time = NOW() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from student where id = #{id}
